title: Replace HubSpot: Build a Custom Marketing CRM in an Afternoon
summary: HubSpot Pro costs $890/month. Here's how to build a custom marketing CRM with contact tracking, deal pipeline, and email sequences — for $15/month on Blink.
body_markdown: [Blink](https://blink.new/) hosts on production infrastructure with uptime SLAs. The database is Postgres — the same database engine HubSpot runs on. For a team of 2-20 people, reliability is not a differentiating factor. For an enterprise sales team of 100+ requiring custom mobile apps, compliance tooling, and Salesforce bi-directional sync, HubSpot or Salesforce remains the right call.
